script:
#!/bin/bash
# 只同步站主记忆档案 vault-data.js 到 VPS（走 raw，带时间戳绕 CDN 缓存）
set -u
BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/main"
EXPECT=72182
TMP=/tmp/_vault_new.js

curl -fsSL "$BASE/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" -o "$TMP" || {
  echo "下载失败"; exit 1; }

SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$TMP")
echo "下载字节: $SIZE (期望 $EXPECT)"
if [ "$SIZE" != "$EXPECT" ]; then
  echo "字节数不符，可能是 CDN 旧缓存，未覆盖"
  head -c 200 "$TMP"; echo; exit 2
fi

# 明文/结构自检：必须是加密信封
grep -q 'PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256' "$TMP" || { echo "结构异常，未覆盖"; exit 3; }
grep -q '2026-11-22T17' "$TMP" || echo "提示：generatedAt 不是最新时间戳，请确认"

sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$TMP" /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
echo "---- 站点自检 ----"
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" | head -c 160; echo
